references.text: The original instruction from God to make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn on the hem of the robe, as Exodus 39:24 describes their execution.
The continuation of the description of the pomegranates and bells that were attached to the hem of the robe.
The instruction to make the robe entirely of blue wool, upon which the pomegranates were to be attached.
The description of the robe itself as it was made, to which the pomegranates in verse 24 were attached.
The same materials (blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, twisted) were used for the tabernacle's tent curtains.
The execution of the work on the tabernacle's tent curtains using the same colors and twisted linen.
The instruction about pomegranates in 28:33 is fulfilled in the execution described in 39:24.
The instruction regarding the order in 28:34 is fulfilled in 39:24.
